reviews.text: I absolutely love this serum! 💗 It feels so nice on the skin, absorbs quickly, and doesn’t leave any sticky feeling. My skin feels soft, hydrated, and looks fresh and healthy after using it. Such a lovely serum — definitely one of my favorites! 🥰
reviews.zh: 我絕對鍾意呢支精華！💗 搽上皮膚感覺好舒服，吸收得好快，唔會有黏笠感。用完之後皮膚變得柔軟、保濕，望落清爽又健康。真心好鍾意呢支精華——絕對係我心水之一！🥰

reviews.text: I’m not sure if this product alone is doing much for my skin. I pair this with a vit c in the morning. I will confusing using this but not sure if it would be on my immediate repurchase checkout bag
reviews.zh: 我唔肯定單用呢件產品對皮膚有冇明顯效果。我朝早會配搭維他命 C 一齊用。我會繼續用住先，但唔確定會唔會即刻加入回購清單。

reviews.text: i did not see notice improovment on my skin after one month used
reviews.zh: 用咗一個月之後，我冇留意到皮膚有明顯改善。

reviews.text: This serum is lightweight and absorbs quickly, helping to brighten dull skin and give a soft, dewy glow. It also hydrates well and can improve skin texture over time, though results may be gradual.
reviews.zh: 呢支精華質地輕盈，吸收得快，有助提亮暗沉肌膚，帶嚟柔軟嘅水光感。保濕效果唔錯，長遠可以改善膚質，不過效果可能需要慢慢先見到。

reviews.text: I really loved the results! My pores minimized and my face feels smooth and whiten a bit. It’s not too heavy on my face and is easily absorbed by my skin. Will definitely purchase again 🥰
reviews.zh: 我真係好滿意效果！毛孔收細咗，塊面摸落滑溜，白淨咗少少。搽上面唔會太厚重，皮膚都好快吸收。一定會再次購買 🥰

reviews.text: The peach scent is amazing! It's not sticky or irritating, so you can use it morning or night. However, those with dry skin might find it insufficient. Be sure to apply a good cream afterward.
reviews.zh: 桃味香氛勁好聞！唔黏笠亦唔刺激，朝早夜晚都適用。不過，乾性肌膚嘅人可能會覺得保濕度唔夠。記得之後再搽一層保濕霜。

reviews.text: my first ever anua serum. i tried this last night and loved how it absorbed into my skin without greasiness and feeling heavy (it has watery consistency). the scent was not strong enough to irritate my nose (the hint of peach was quite lovely). i woke up feeling my skin hydrated and light.
reviews.zh: 我人生第一支 anua 精華。琴晚試咗，好鍾意佢吸收得咁快，唔會有油笠感或者厚重感（質地似水）。味道唔算濃烈，唔會刺激鼻（桃味幾清香）。第二朝起身皮膚感覺保濕又輕盈。

reviews.text: I’m very happy with this serum! The texture is light, absorbs quickly, and doesn’t leave any stickiness. It hydrates the skin beautifully and evens out my skin tone — noticeably reduces redness and dullness. I especially love how it improves skin texture: my face looks fresh, smoother, and radiant. A great daily care product — I recommend it to anyone who wants to enhance their skin tone and overall skin condition!
reviews.zh: 我對呢支精華好滿意！質地輕盈，吸收得快，唔會有黏笠感。保濕效果出色，均勻膚色——明顯減淡泛紅同暗沉。我尤其鍾意佢改善膚質嘅效果：塊面望落清爽、更滑、更有光澤。係一款出色嘅日常護膚品——推薦畀任何想提升膚色同整體膚質嘅人！

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
